Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished stained-glass artwork revealed on completion of a four-colour puzzle game, part of a cohesive three-level set. Image 1 is the EXACT layout and colour assignment to preserve. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for realistic glass material, not its composition or colours. Transform image 1 into exquisite photographic artisan stained glass: luminous translucent jewel-coloured glass, subtle organic ripples, tiny trapped bubbles, delicate hammered texture, realistic glass thickness and narrow dark aged lead seams. Warm light transmitted from behind, natural specular highlights, refined material richness with clearly readable large panes. CRITICAL: preserve every seam position, curve, pane boundary, four-colour assignment and outer silhouette EXACTLY from image 1; do not add, delete, merge, split, shift, or reinterpret any pane. Do not add decorative details, cracks, eyes, veins, extra lines or objects. Match Image 1 framing exactly on a portrait 3:4 canvas, preferably 768x1024 or 1536x2048. Strict orthographic front view, full panel with the same size and placement as the guide. Outside the silhouette keep a uniform neutral light grey background. No frame, wall, room, chains, perspective, cast shadows, vignette, typography, logos or watermark. Deliver one finished raster image.
Level 2: Deniz Kaplumbağası. A circular stained-glass medallion depicting a geometric sea turtle swimming with four flippers and a tessellated oval shell. Preserve the guide's EXACT round silhouette, head, shell, flippers and all background seams. Do not add eyes or anatomical details. Four glass hues ONLY: sea green #2a9d8f, sandy beige #f1dcb0, salmon coral #fa8072, deep sea blue #264b7a.
